faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.replyNote: We usually reply in under 2 hours.

items.question: Do I need gym experience to start?
items.answer: Not at all. I work with beginners and advanced athletes alike. Your program will be tailored to your current experience level, and I'll teach you everything you need to know.

items.question: Is nutrition coaching included?
items.answer: Yes, all plans include nutrition guidance. The level of detail varies by plan — from basic guidelines in Starter to fully customized meal planning in Pro and Elite.

items.question: Can I work with you from anywhere?
items.answer: Absolutely. My programs work from anywhere in the world. You'll receive a fully personalised training and nutrition plan, regular check-ins via video call, and dedicated expert support every step of the way.

items.question: How quickly will I see results?
items.answer: Most clients notice visible changes within 3–4 weeks. Significant transformations typically take 12–16 weeks. Sustainable results require consistency, and that's exactly what we build together.

items.question: What if I have injuries or limitations?
items.answer: No problem. I'll design your program around any injuries or limitations. I have extensive experience working with various conditions and will always ensure safe, effective training.

items.question: How often will we check progress?
items.answer: Weekly for Pro and Elite plans, monthly for Starter. Progress tracking includes measurements, photos, performance metrics, and subjective feedback.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. I want you in the program that best serves your needs and goals.

items.question: What equipment do I need?
items.answer: It depends on your program. I can design plans for full gym access, home gym setups, or even minimal equipment. We'll discuss this during your consultation.
